```python
def is_bored(S):
    sentences = S.split('.')
    sentences.extend(part for s in sentences for part in s.split('?'))
    sentences.extend(part for s in sentences if '?' not in s for part in s.split('!'))
    
    return sum(sentence.strip().startswith('I') for sentence in sentences)
```

```python
def is_bored(S):
    sentences = S.split('.')
    sentences = [sentence.split('?') for sentence in sentences]
    sentences = [item for sublist in sentences for item in sublist]
    sentences = [sentence.split('!') for sentence in sentences]
    sentences = [item for sublist in sentences for item in sublist]
    return sum(1 for sentence in sentences if sentence.strip().startswith('I'))
```
